rationale.area: The change is in the global Vue store (web/src/stores/index.ts), which is app-wide theming rather than a Logs/Metrics/etc. product feature. It maps to GeneralTests, where global cross-cutting UI behaviors are placed.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the closest existing shard group for global app-level behavior (theme), matching the append list in the enterprise ci-matrix overlay which already carries GeneralTests specs.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — the only changed file is web/src/stores/index.ts, a TypeScript store file, not a tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js spec. No Playwright coverage is being added by this change.
